cards.name: Akki Avalanchers
cards.oracleText: Sacrifice a land: This creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.

cards.name: Goblinslide
cards.oracleText: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may pay {1}. If you do, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token with haste.

cards.name: Geological Appraiser
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you cast it, discover 3. (Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value 3 or less. Cast it without paying its mana cost or put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.)

cards.name: Avalanche Tusker
cards.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature defending player controls blocks it this combat if able.

cards.name: Avalanche Riders
cards.oracleText:
Haste
Echo {3}{R} (At the beginning of your upkeep, if this came under your control since the beginning of your last upkeep, sacrifice it unless you pay its echo cost.)
When this creature enters, destroy target land.

cards.name: Avalanche of Sector 7
cards.oracleText:
Menace
Avalanche of Sector 7's power is equal to the number of artifacts your opponents control.
Whenever an opponent activates an ability of an artifact they control, Avalanche of Sector 7 deals 1 damage to that player.

cards.name: Corpse Appraiser
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile up to one target creature card from a graveyard. If a card is put into exile this way, look at the top three cards of your library, then put one of those cards into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.

cards.name: Avalanche Caller
cards.oracleText: {2}: Target snow land you control becomes a 4/4 Elemental creature with hexproof and haste until end of turn. It's still a land. (A creature with hexproof can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)

cards.name: Pinpoint Avalanche
cards.oracleText: Pinpoint Avalanche deals 4 damage to target creature. The damage can't be prevented.
